note: The Pocket Library's shelf, in order. Each book: its id (the file name of its normalized text), how the spine is lettered (title, subtitle), the shelf it stands on (category), its binding (hex RGB; leather or cloth), and how it is read: importer 'own' for the first library's works (import_books.py has a reader for each), or 'epub' / 'gutenberg-text' with the source id and file name pinned in sources.lock.json. Each book also names its block (block), the part of the library whose code holds it: books added together share a new block, coded against the frozen base (make_library.cpp), so adding them rebuilds nothing else.
